basic_details.job_title: GBU Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Biotechnology University (GBU), an initiative of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat, has invited applications for 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post on a Department of Biotechnology (Govt. of India) funded project. The fellowship pays 37000/- + applicable HRA (as per DBT norms) and is initially for 1 year. Applicants need an M. Sc. in any branch of biological sciences with NET / GATE or an equivalent national-level exam. They must apply through an online form with supporting documents on or before 04 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of the post.

qualification.details: M. Sc. in any branch of biological sciences from any reputed university, with NET / GATE or an equivalent national-level exam qualified as per funding agency norms. Candidates with DBT category I and II are eligible as per funding agency rules.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates apply to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Dhaval Patel), Gujarat Biotechnology University, Gandhinagar.
Fill up the online application form at https://forms.gle/PymP6HEnUBbEDnR39.
Upload supporting documents, including the latest CV and other credentials.
Complete the application on or before 04 December 2026.
For queries about the project, write to [email protected] with the latest credentials. The general query phone number printed in the notice is +91 99099 57407.
important_instructions: The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project. The selected candidate(s) will work in collaboration with other collaborating institutes. NET / GATE or the equivalent qualification must be as per funding agency norms.

rows.details: An Al-Driven Platform for Discovering and Validating Anti-Aggregation Compounds for Alzheimer's and Related Neurodegenerative Diseases
Department of Biotechnology, Govt. of India
Initially for 1 year, extendable until duration of the project, subject to satisfactory progress, and financial provisions
Up to 28 years on closing date of advertisement or as per the university norms

content_sections.heading: About GBU
content_sections.text: Gujarat Biotechnology University is an initiative of the Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat. Its address in the notice is Gujarat International Finance Tec-City (GIFT city), Gandhinagar, Gujarat - 382355, INDIA. The post is on a research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Dhaval Patel, who is also an Assistant Professor at the university.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M. Sc. in any branch of biological sciences from any reputed university, with NET / GATE or an equivalent national-level exam qualified as per funding agency norms. Candidates with DBT category I and II are eligible as per funding agency rules. Prior hands-on experience with protein/peptide handling and biophysical techniques such as fluorescence spectroscopy and Circular Dichroism (CD). Experience in microplate-based assays (96/384-well) and data analysis. Prior research experience in protein/peptide aggregation (e.g., Tau, α-Synuclein, Aβ), including ThT kinetics. Familiarity with binding assays such as Fluorescence Polarization (FP), TR-FRET or Biolayer Interferometry (BLI), and with particle sizing (DLS/NTA). Working knowledge of Python/R for data processing, curation and visualization. Candidates with experience/skills in AI/ML in biology, molecular dynamics and big-data analytics will be given preference. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emolument is 37000/- + applicable HRA (as per DBT norms). The fellowship is initially for 1 year and is extendable until the duration of the project, subject to satisfactory progress and financial provisions. The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GBU Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates apply to the Principal Investigator (Dr. Dhaval Patel), Gujarat Biotechnology University, Gandhinagar. Fill up the online application form at https://forms.gle/PymP6HEnUBbEDnR39 . Upload supporting documents, including the latest CV and other credentials. Complete the application on or before 04 December 2026. For queries about the project, write to [email protected] with the latest credentials. The general query phone number printed in the notice is +91 99099 57407. Latest CV Other credentials (supporting documents)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed through email regarding the interview process. The notice does not describe the interview date, mode or marking.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and co-terminates with the project. The selected candidate(s) will work in collaboration with other collaborating institutes. NET / GATE or the equivalent qualification must be as per funding agency norms.
